title: The workshop
passage: The teacher showed a simple example, then let us try it ourselves. My first attempt felt unfamiliar. I noticed one thing I wanted to change and tried again. By the end, I understood the instruction differently because I had experienced it.
steps: Read aloud once in your ordinary way.
Choose one feature or tool to explore.
Read the same text again with that one choice.
Save one observation and one real-life use.
reflection: What changed in effort or meaning?
